pedido: Short: "The Ocean Sound Nobody Could Explain: The Bloop". In 1997 NOAA underwater microphones recorded an ultra-low-frequency sound louder than any known animal, heard across thousands of km. People speculated about a giant unknown creature. Years later it was matched to icequakes: huge icebergs cracking off Antarctica. Build mystery first, reveal at the end. Hook: "In 1997, the ocean made a sound louder than any animal alive."

videos.description:
Did you believe it was a monster? 👇

The Bloop: the mysterious ocean sound recorded by NOAA in 1997, and what it really was.
It was heard by sensors more than 3,000 miles apart, and it turned out to be icebergs cracking off Antarctica.
